verdict.rationale: Oneleet is a compliance platform, so AI questionnaire answering is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence pack never documents AI-drafted security questionnaire answers grounded in controls or a knowledge base. The nearby items are other features: a Trust Center, vCISO help with security reviews, Fieldwork AI agents that collect evidence, and an MCP server for external assistants. None of these is the questionnaire-drafting capability itself, so none earns credit.

support.subject: As a sales lead, security questionnaires get answered by AI from my actual controls and knowledge base — drafts I review, not blank spreadsheets I fill
